methodology.title: Analysis Methodology
methodology.desc: BedaanWaves employs a multi-faceted approach to financial analysis, combining traditional fundamental/technical analysis with cutting-edge machine learning techniques. Each analysis type serves a specific purpose in the investment decision-making process.
methodology.disclaimer_desc: This is an analytical tool, not financial advice.
methodology.accuracy_desc: Results based on historical data, not guaranteed future performance.

scoring.title: 6D Scoring System
scoring.details: Uses a 4-level hierarchy with 305 nodes to evaluate investments across six equally-weighted dimensions. Machine learning dynamically optimizes weights based on historical performance.
steps: Collect data across six dimensions (fundamental, technical, sentiment, risk, macro, AI)
Calculate individual scores (0-100) for each dimension
Apply ML-optimized weights to dimension scores
Compute final weighted score and assign grade (A-E)

ranking.title: Ranking System
ranking.details: Users can rank by any of the six dimensions or the composite score. Results are cached for 5 minutes to reduce API load.
steps: Calculate 6D scores for all eligible securities
Sort by selected metric (overall score or specific dimension)
Return top N results (default: 10)

technical.title: Technical Analysis
technical.details: Provides 50+ technical indicators including momentum oscillators, trend-following tools, and volatility measures.
steps: Fetch historical price/volume data (minimum 20 periods)
Calculate indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands)
Summarize indicator readings and trend direction

fundamental.title: Fundamental Analysis
fundamental.details: Analyzes income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements from multiple global data sources.
steps: Retrieve latest financial statements from CODAL, Yahoo Finance, or Alpha Vantage
Calculate key ratios (P/E, P/B, ROE, Debt/Equity, etc.)
Assess earnings quality and growth sustainability

momentum.title: Momentum Analysis
momentum.details: Focuses on relative strength and trend persistence to identify potential outperformers.
steps: Calculate price changes over multiple timeframes (1D, 1W, 1M, 3M)
Identify assets with strongest relative momentum
Filter for stocks showing consistent upward trends

risk.title: Risk Analysis
risk.details: Provides comprehensive risk metrics including maximum drawdown, beta, and tail risk measures.
steps: Calculate daily returns from historical price data
Compute volatility (standard deviation of returns)
Calculate Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Conditional VaR
Determine Sharpe, Sortino, and Calmar ratios

sentiment.title: Sentiment Analysis
sentiment.desc: Market sentiment from news and social media
sentiment.details: Uses transformer-based NLP models to analyze text sentiment from multiple sources in real-time.
steps: Collect financial news and social media mentions
Apply NLP models to extract sentiment scores
Aggregate sentiment by source and time period

ai.title: AI/ML Analysis
ai.details: Combines time series forecasting, pattern recognition, and anomaly detection for predictive insights.
steps: Train LSTM/Prophet models on historical price data
Generate price forecasts for multiple time horizons
Detect chart patterns and anomalies using computer vision

scoring.title: 6D Scoring Drill-Down
scoring.system_desc: The 6D scoring system evaluates stocks across six dimensions: Fundamental, Technical, Sentiment, Risk, Macro, and AI factors. The scoring algorithm uses 305 hierarchical nodes across four levels to calculate a final score between 0-100.
scoring.ml_desc: Static weights serve as fallback values. The ML service dynamically optimizes these weights weekly based on historical performance data.
